caveats: Requires Paseo 0.8.x and a separately installed official Antigravity ACP server.
Authenticate the official ACP server before use; Paseo 0.8 cannot start its login flow.
Official server 1.1.1 ignores Paseo system prompts; workflows relying on them are unsupported.
Real-agent verification: macOS ARM64 only; see README for other official distributions.
The current shim/server can display duplicate tool rows and split streamed text.
